```python
def solve(case):
    payload = case.get("payload", case)
    nodes_list = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build node lookup
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes_list}
    
    # Validate required fields
    for n in nodes_list:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in n:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node {n.get('id', '?')}")
    
    # Build children map
    children = {nid: [] for nid in nodes}
    for n in nodes_list:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            if n["parent"] not in nodes:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {n['parent']} not found for node {n['id']}")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Sort candidates: depth descending, node_id ascending (lexicographic)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes_list, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    # Start with all nodes retained
    maintained = set(nodes.keys())
    removal_order = []
    
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n["id"]
        
        # Skip non-removable nodes
        if not n["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip nodes with required symbols
        if n["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        if any(child in maintained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols remain
        test_maintained = maintained - {nid}
        symbols_present = {nodes[mid]["symbol"] for mid in test_maintained}
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_present):
            maintained.discard(nid)
            removal_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_ids = sorted(maintained)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": retained_ids,
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```
